caption: The drawing depicts a console table with a rectangular shape that curves outward at the center. The tabletop is a white or light gray color suggestive of marble. The apron just below the surface is a reddish-brown color with decorative gold patterns, including symmetrical flourishes and a central medallion. The corners of the apron each feature square gold designs. Supporting the table are two cylindrical, white columns at the front corners with gold Corinthian capitals and bases. The rear legs are solid blocks of the same reddish-brown as the apron. The lower stretcher is also reddish-brown with gold ornamentation and curves to match the outline of the table. The feet of the table are sculpted in the form of large animal paws, shaded in gray and gold. The artist's signature, "Rothenberg," appears in red in the bottom right corner. The background is a plain, light tan or cream color, showing no other objects or elements.
title: Console Table
